start: Trainers, the day grid; a booking later today

steps.action: Tap the member’s name in a booked cell
must_not: 'Did they come? Tap "Mark session" …' before the booking has started
A class taken from the member by cancelling
The booking still in the grid after the note

start: Other entry: a row of 'Bookings this week' on a trainer’s page, then 'Open member'

steps.action: On a trainer’s page tap a row of 'Bookings this week'

user_sees: That member’s page, where 'Mark session' lives

start: Negative: a booking that has started, opened by someone who is not the owner; and a failed cancel

steps.action: As a desk person, open a booking whose start time has passed
user_sees: 'This booking has started, so only the gym owner can cancel it.'
'Did they come? Tap "Mark session" on the member’s page.'
must_not: 'Cancel booking' offered to a non-owner after the start

steps.action: As the owner, open the same booking
must_not: The owner told that only the owner can cancel

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel booking' when the server refuses or cannot be reached
user_sees: A red box with the reason in plain words; the sheet stays open; the button is usable again

start: State: the same booking before and after its start time; after cancelling

steps.action: As a desk person, open a booking one minute before its start and keep the sheet open past the start
user_sees: First 'Cancel booking'; within a minute the button goes and 'This booking has started, so only the gym owner can cancel it.' shows
must_not: A cancel that still goes through from the old button after the start

steps.action: Cancel a future booking, then look for it
user_sees: Gone from the grid and from the trainer’s 'Bookings this week'; the member’s booked count is one lower
must_not: A way to open the cancelled booking and cancel it twice

start: Privacy and promise: 'This booking has started, so only the gym owner can cancel it.'

steps.action: As a desk person, try to cancel a started booking by any way the screen offers
must_not: The server accepting the cancel from a non-owner after the start (the server side was not read)

user_sees: Member name, classes left, who booked
must_not: The member’s phone number, dues or plan price in the booking sheet
